First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual, beginner-friendly. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Montana Dirt Girls Tuesday Ride group ride

A women's and female-centered outdoor meetup that mountain bikes on Tuesday evenings from spring into fall and hikes the rest of the year. Location changes each week and goes out by email and on Facebook. Casual and social. Anyone looking for a female-centered space is welcome.
